resolved_findings.evidence: All three reachable Financial MCP paths use the Financial-owned allowlisted trace wrapper. Independent PRIVATE_SENTINEL coverage confirms raw arguments, MCP results, filing text, DCF arrays, and exception text are excluded while validated identity, bounded counts, outcome, and stable error codes remain.

Financial server and agent logging uses fixed registry-validated events and bounded counts. The focused caplog sentinel confirms raw price, EPS, revenue, debt, cash, EBITDA, assets, DCF inputs, and private failure text are not persisted.

The immutable Stage 05 identity and measured payload-free lifecycle cover all 12 required SEC, Yahoo, dispatcher, adapter, agent, checker, and pre-Shared-State boundaries. The independent lifecycle matrix sentinel passed.
